items.summary: Audit the centralized translations file (frontend/src/translations/translations.ts) for all three language codes (en, hi, mr) and ensure every translation value is a plain, human-readable string. Replace any raw JSON objects, escaped characters, template literal artifacts, untranslated key strings, or stringified arrays with proper readable prose or formatted text. No translation value should ever render as a technical string on screen.

Audit every component that consumes the language context (NavBar, HeroSection, AboutSection, ProductsSection, QualityComplianceSection, ExportCargoSection, SocialMediaSection, ContactSection, Footer, ExportCertificationPage, PrivacyPolicyPage, TermsAndConditionsPage) and fix any location where a raw translation key, escaped character sequence, JSON fragment, or template literal artifact is being rendered as visible text instead of the resolved translation string. Each component must call the t() helper correctly and interpolate values where needed.

Add complete Hindi (hi) and Marathi (mr) translations for any key that currently has a missing, empty, or placeholder value in those language codes within frontend/src/translations/translations.ts. Every key present in the English (en) object must have a corresponding non-empty, human-readable value in both hi and mr, so that switching to Hindi or Marathi never causes a raw key fallback to be displayed.
